mods.name: Cut Content Restoration
mods.description: Restores dozens of unused missions, weapons, arts and Skells.
mods.author: threethan
mods.notes: Uses the mod's game data files; its Switch code plugin (exefs) is not needed on XCX Recomp. Changes data loaded at boot, so restart the game after turning it on or off. Missions or items it adds may vanish from a save made with it if it is removed.

mods.name: Tweaks mod
mods.description: Quality-of-life tweaks: every chance shown as a percentage, Skells in time attack and support missions, larger storage probes, stronger treasure sensors, more appendage targeting, more multi-guns and earlier DLC missions.
mods.author: Fhav6X

parts.name: All tweaks
parts.description: Every tweak of the mod in one file.

parts.name: Treasure sensor up
parts.description: Treasure sensor augments are stronger: two of the best reach the highest drop chance.

mods.notes: Nexus Mods allows downloads only from its own page, so Install opens the page and asks for the files you downloaded. Take All tweaks, or only the options you want. All tweaks is a whole common.bdat; the options are single bdat tables that the game merges into its own at start-up, which needs an XCX Recomp build with the bdat merge. Restart the game after turning a part on or off.
